name: cassquery
description: A local desktop viewer for CadQuery projects — live preview tier, certified gated builds, semantic payloads, and a loopback agent protocol.

scripts.check: node --check shell/main.js && node --check shell/runtime.cjs && node --check shell/smoke.cjs && node --check tools/viewer_render.cjs && node --input-type=module --check < viewer/app.js && python3 -m py_compile worker.py tools/macos_smoke.py tools/worker_smoke.py tools/dmg_smoke.py tools/check_release.py
scripts.test: npm run check && node --test tests/*.cjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:worker && electron-builder --config packaging/electron-builder.json --mac --publish never
scripts.build:mac:dir: npm run build:worker && electron-builder --config packaging/electron-builder.json --mac --dir --publish never
